item.text: The exporter stops when a page contains fewer active records than requested, even if the gateway supplies a continuation cursor. Project exports mask the same bug by using a hardcoded page size of 1,000. I’ll make pagination follow the cursor and remove that workaround so both exports honor `pageSize`.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Exports now follow continuation cursors until `null`, including after sparse or empty pages. Your example exports both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Removed the project page-size workaround so projects also honor `pageSize`.

All 5 tests pass, including new pagination regressions; `git diff --check` passes.
